title: MS Dynamics 365 F&O Technical Consultant
description:
**About the Company**

Altum is a Microsoft Business Applications consultancy delivering end-to-end Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem. Our Customer Engagement practice designs and builds Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, and Power Platform solutions — integrated with Azure, Microsoft Fabric, and our clients' broader technology landscape — to help organizations modernize how they sell, serve, and operate. We work across consulting, implementation, integration, data & analytics, and managed services, and we hold ourselves to Microsoft best practice on every engagement.

**About this role**

We are looking for a Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Technical Consultant who is equally comfortable in Visual Studio and in front of a client. You will own the technical delivery of D365 F&O extensions, data migrations, and integrations across implementation and modernization projects — and you will be the day-to-day technical voice to the client, running the daily cadence, driving blockers to closure, and translating technical detail into language business stakeholders can act on.

This is a client-facing role. Strong engineering skills are the entry requirement; the differentiator is the ability to lead a conversation, hold a commitment, and keep a client confident in the delivery

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Delivery**

* Design, develop, and unit test extensions to D365 F&O using X++, the extension framework, Chain of Command, and event handlers — no over-layering, no upgrade-blocking customization.
* Build and maintain integrations using the Data Management Framework, OData, custom services, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, and Event Grid.
* Deliver data migration: source profiling, mapping, staging, DMF entity development, load sequencing, reconciliation, and cutover dry runs.
* Develop and extend SSRS reports; support Power BI and Microsoft Fabric reporting where F&O data is surfaced via Synapse Link / OneLake.
* Manage environments, builds, and releases through LCS and Azure DevOps pipelines; maintain branching, code review, and deployment discipline.
* Troubleshoot performance issues (SQL, indexing, batch, integration throughput) and produce root-cause analysis, not just workarounds.
* Uphold One Version upgrade readiness: assess regression impact, run and remediate against release waves, and keep customizations upgrade-safe.
* Produce and maintain technical design documents, integration specifications, and hand-over documentation to a client-ready standard.

**Client Communication & Cadence Leadership**

* Run the daily cadence/stand-up with the client: agenda, progress against plan, blockers, decisions needed, and clear owners and dates.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for assigned workstreams — answer client questions directly and credibly without escalating every item.
* Facilitate requirement and design walkthroughs with functional consultants and business stakeholders; challenge requirements where a standard feature beats a build.
* Maintain and publish the action, decision, and risk log; chase items to closure rather than reporting the same blocker twice.
* Give status honestly and early. Flag slippage, scope creep, and risk before it becomes a surprise.
* Support UAT: triage defects, agree severity with the client, communicate fix timelines, and drive sign-off.
* Contribute to go-live and hypercare: cutover task ownership, on-call support windows, and post-go-live issue communication.

**Team & Practice**

* Contribute reusable assets, patterns, and accelerators back to the practice.
* Support estimation and solution shaping for new opportunities in your technical area

**Technical Skills Required**

* **2-6 years years**
  of hands-on Dynamics 365 F&O (or AX 2012 with demonstrated migration to D365 F&O) technical experience.
* Strong X++ development skills, including the extension model, Chain of Command, event handlers, and the D365 F&O data model (Finance, Supply Chain, or both).
* Demonstrated integration experience with at least two of: DMF, OData, custom services, Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus.
* Solid T-SQL and data modelling ability; comfortable investigating data issues independently.
* Practical experience with LCS, Azure DevOps (repos, pipelines, work items), and structured release management.
* **Minimum 1 full-lifecycle implementation**
  taken through to go-live in a technical role.
* Proven client-facing experience: has independently run recurring client meetings and owned communication for a workstream.
* Excellent written and verbal English; able to write a clear status update and a clean design document.

**Preferred Skills**

* Microsoft certifications: MB-500 (F&O Developer), MB-300, or Azure fundamentals/integration certifications.
* Experience with Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) and Dataverse dual-write.
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric, Lakehouse, and semantic model design for D365 reporting modernization.
* EDI, 3PL / WMS, banking, payment gateway, or e-commerce (Shopify) integration experience.
* Manufacturing, distribution, or multi-company / multi-entity rollout experience.
* Familiarity with Success by Design and Microsoft implementation guidance.
* Consulting or partner-side delivery background.

**Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)

**Employee Benefits & Growth Opportunities**

Altum offers a professional and supportive work environment with opportunities for career growth and skill development.

Employees benefit from:

* Health insurance and employee well-being support
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities
* Exposure to global clients and emerging technologies
* A collaborative culture that encourages ownership and innovation
* Long-term career growth aligned with organizational expansion

**Altum is an equal opportunity employer.**

title: Principal Engineer - Confluent
description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Software, we transform client challenges into solutions. Building the world’s leading AI-powered, cloud-native products that shape the future of business and society. Our legacy of innovation creates endless opportunities for IBMers to learn, grow, and make an impact on a global scale. Working in Software means joining a team fueled by curiosity and collaboration. You’ll work with diverse technologies, partners, and industries to design, develop, and deliver solutions that power digital transformation. With a culture that values innovation, growth, and continuous learning, IBM Software places you at the heart of IBM’s product and technology landscape. Here, you’ll have the tools and opportunities to advance your career while creating software that changes the world.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
**About the job**
We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.
  
  
It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.
  
  
One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are building Kafka Connect charter which is core for scalable and reliable streaming data between Apache Kafka® and other data systems. It makes it simple to quickly define connectors that move large data sets in and out of Kafka. Kafka Connect can ingest entire databases or collect metrics from all your application servers into Kafka topics, making the data available for stream processing with low latency. An export connector can deliver data from Kafka topics into secondary indexes like Elasticsearch, or into batch systems–such as Hadoop for offline analysis.
  
  
We are looking for a Principal Engineer to lead the technical vision, architecture, execution, and operations of core engineering teams that build Confluent's industry-leading Kafka Connectors.. As an IC leader of this product line, you will be responsible for guiding the world-class Connect team in driving innovation and outpacing competitors.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Work with a strong team of engineers to help evolve Confluent Connect. Work closely with product management, engineering leadership, and other key stakeholders across various teams in Confluent to build and drive the overall roadmap.
* Drive the long-term direction and strategy of Confluent Kafka connectors, while partnering with internal stakeholders to drive the team’s mission forward
* Drive the technical charter for Connect, and create competitive advantages for Kafka connectors by driving innovation. Drive improvements in the Kafka connectors to make them more usable and powerful for customers, and make them easier to adopt and scale.
* Mentor a team of high-performing engineers and leads, helping them to continue in growing their skill set through hands-on experience and mentorship. Provide timely and productive feedback, encourage a growth mindset, and advise team members in setting and working toward personal development goals.
* Build a culture of continuous improvement and prioritise large and high-impact initiatives that will fundamentally change Kafka connectors.
* Be a strong technical leader and representative for engineering teams in India. Nurture a culture of excellence on the team through a focus on hiring, communication, execution, and work quality. Create and manage processes that enable the team to do its best work.
* Continue a strong growth trajectory by hiring top tier engineers, and establish quality standards, design principles, and operational maturity for the team

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Minimum of 15+ years of hands-on software development experience with the ability to anticipate future technical needs for the product and craft plans to realize them.
* Taking ideas to production is something we look for. Ready to roll up your sleeves - code, debug, design - do whatever it takes to ship the product to production.
* Experience building and operating large-scale systems. Experience running production services in public clouds.
* Strong fundamentals in distributed systems design and development.
* A self starter with the ability to work effectively in teams. Proactively identifying the symptoms of technical issues and reason about their causes is needed. This will be followed by fixing the root causes.
* Timely shipping of deliverables; being able to trade-off short term technical decisions with the long term. Move fast, build in increments, and iterate. A sense of urgency, a mindset towards achieving results, and excellent prioritization skills.
* Ability to influence the team, peers and upper management in technology decisions using effective communication and collaborative techniques
* Strong mentorship track record, guiding the team in building out complex systems, and helping them in their professional development.
* Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience. Understanding of various technologies, programming paradigms and frameworks is needed. Ability to be pragmatic and trade off their usage in production is essential.
* Ability to take on intense customer production issues on-call; debugging and mitigating them will be needed. This requires patient log and metrics analysis with solid reasoning to nail the issue.

The ideal candidate pairs deep technical mastery with proven team-handling experience, translating business challenges into production-ready software with strict performance, cost, and reliability benchmarks.

* Guide database modelling, stored procedure optimization, indexing strategies, and execution plan analysis across PostgreSQL and SQL Server (SSMS).
* Oversee programmatic extraction and tabular aggregation directly from Power BI reports and semantic models using DAX.

* Define logging, telemetry, anomaly detection, and alerting standards to minimize production downtime and pipeline breakages.

* Experience: 7+ years of hands-on technical experience across data engineering, analytics engineering, or applied AI/ML systems, including 2+ years of formal leadership or team management experience.
* Full Lifecycle Delivery: Proven track record of owning projects from initial requirement discovery and architecture design through deployment, production rollout, and operational monitoring.



**Required Skills**

* Databases & Querying:
* Advanced proficiency in PostgreSQL and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), including database design, query optimization, indexing, and deep execution plan profiling.
* Strong working proficiency in writing and optimizing DAX queries against Power BI datasets and tabular models.

**NetSuite implementation and solution ownership**

**Financial management and controls**

* Support the design and configuration of general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash management, bank reconciliation, intercompany activity, financial dimensions, allocations, fixed assets, and period close

* Partner with Finance to establish approvals, role permissions, audit trails, segregation of duties, and other control requirements.

**Order to cash and customer operations**

* Design and support customer master data, sales orders, pricing, allocations, fulfillment, invoicing, payments, returns, credits, and related workflows.
* Support both owned-inventory and drop-ship transaction models, including customer-specific item references and order requirements.
* Evaluate the effect of design choices on customer service, warehouse execution, fulfillment accuracy, margin, and accounting.

**Procure to pay inventory and warehouse processes**

* Design and support vendor master data, purchasing, purchase orders, receiving, vendor bills, matching, landed cost, payments, and returns.

* Configure or oversee roles, permissions, forms, fields, workflows, saved searches, dashboards, approval processes, and application preferences.

* Support production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and manage an enhancement backlog based on business value, control risk, and operational need.

**Master data testing and cutover**

* Help define customer, vendor, item, pricing, chart-of-accounts, location, and other master-data structures, ownership, approval rights, and system-of-record boundaries.
* Participate in data mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with clear acceptance criteria.

title: NetSuite Integration Architect
description:
**About the Company:**

Relay Human Cloud is a young & dynamic company that helps some of the top US-based companies to expand their team internationally. Relay is a truly global company having its operations in US, India, Honduras, and Mexico (We are also adding a few more countries soon). Our core focus is to enable companies to connect with the best international talent. Relay helps its clients in majorly following areas: Accounting & Finance, Administration, Operations, Space Planning, Leasing, Data Science, Data Search, Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence etc. Relay India operates from Ahmedabad and Vadodara offices. The principals and founders of Relay Human Cloud have been focused on delivering high-quality operations in cutting-edge companies for their entire careers.

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Manager – Enterprise Integration & Data Architecture with strong NetSuite integration expertise to design, develop, and maintain enterprise integrations, APIs, EDI, and data pipelines. The ideal candidate will have strong technical skills and a solid understanding of distribution, inventory, order processing, and accounting workflows. This role focuses on hands-on implementation, troubleshooting, and long-term technical ownership rather than project management.

**Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise integration architecture**

* Design and maintain the company's enterprise integration architecture, including approved patterns for APIs, EDI, webhooks, SFTP, files, native connectors, events, and batch processing.
* Define source and target systems, authoritative data boundaries, field mappings, timing, sequencing, validation, error handling, retry, reconciliation, security, and support ownership for each interface.
* Avoid uncontrolled point-to-point connections, duplicated business logic, and integrations that create parallel systems of record.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, interface inventories, mapping specifications, decision records, and runbooks while determining which existing interfaces should be retained, redesigned, replaced, or retired.

**NetSuite integration engineering**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and support integrations between NetSuite and internal or external systems.
* Develop deep knowledge of the NetSuite record, transaction, permission, and posting models so interfaces create valid operational and accounting results.
* Work with applicable NetSuite capabilities such as REST web services, SuiteTalk, RESTlets, SuiteScript, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, web services, and token-based authentication.
* Use Oracle integration technologies where appropriate, establish reusable engineering patterns, and challenge partner-proposed designs before owning the deployed solution and support model.

**Customer vendor and external ecosystem integration**

* Support EDI and API connectivity for customers, broadline distributors, vendors, logistics providers, marketplaces, payment services, websites, and other business partners.
* Design mappings and workflows for relevant documents such as purchase orders, acknowledgments, advance ship notices, invoices, inventory updates, item data, pricing, and order status.
* Support vendor onboarding, customer enablement, item synchronization, pricing exchange, order ingestion, fulfillment status, and other digital transaction flows while keeping partner-specific rules documented and controlled.
* Build repeatable onboarding patterns that reduce the cost and time required to connect new customers, vendors, and acquisitions.

**Data architecture ownership and governance**

* Help define company's enterprise data architecture with NetSuite as the authoritative transactional platform for the processes it owns.
* Establish clear boundaries for transactional, master, analytical, historical, reference, and external application data.
* Partner with business and application owners to define authoritative sources, data ownership, approval rights, stewardship, quality rules, and lifecycle requirements.
* Design governed data pipelines, transformation logic, shared definitions, and reconciliations so critical item, pricing, costing, inventory, margin, customer, vendor, and financial logic remains transparent and auditable.

**Legacy discovery migration and transition**

* Inspect legacy applications, databases, scripts, interfaces, files, and automated jobs to identify embedded business rules and technical dependencies.
* Document why existing functionality exists before replacing it, separating requirements that must be preserved from obsolete workarounds and technical debt.
* Support extraction, transformation, mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with repeatable utilities and control totals that preserve financial, operational, and referential integrity.
* Plan retirement, archival, access, and support arrangements for legacy data and applications that will not move into the future environment.

**Analytics data services and application enablement**

* Support the architecture and ongoing operation of NetSuite Analytics Warehouse and related analytics capabilities where adopted.
* Define the appropriate roles of NetSuite native reporting, governed analytical platforms, Power BI, and other reporting tools so business logic is not recreated inconsistently.
* Design data models and pipelines that provide trusted reporting and reconcile to source transactions.
* Support approved extension platforms for internal tools, portals, and workflows, and enable automation or AI only through governed data, controlled interfaces, clear ownership, and appropriate human review.

**Testing monitoring security and operational support**

* Develop and execute unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, failure-mode, cutover, and reconciliation testing with documented acceptance criteria.
* Implement logging, automated alerts, transaction tracing, exception queues, retry mechanisms, dashboards, and escalation procedures so failures are visible and actionable.
* Perform hands-on production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across systems, data, network, authentication, mapping, sequencing, and business-rule layers.
* Apply secure access and data protection while establishing standards for source control, code review, automated testing, environment separation, deployment, versioning, rollback, documentation, and change control.

**Long term architecture ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner for enterprise integrations, data pipelines, interface standards, and supporting technical documentation.
* Work side by side with implementation-partner engineers during design and build activities rather than receiving knowledge only at the end of the program.
* Build internal support capability, reduce unnecessary dependence on external consultants, and prioritize technical debt and enhancements based on business value, reliability, control risk, total cost, and operational impact.
* Create scalable patterns that support growth, acquisition integration, customer and vendor enablement, analytics, automation, and future digital services

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of enterprise application integration, software engineering, data engineering, or related technical experience.
* Meaningful hands-on experience integrating with NetSuite and working with its records, transactions, permissions, APIs, or scripting capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of REST and SOAP services, JSON, XML, SQL, SFTP, webhooks, authentication, and modern integration patterns.
* Experience designing, building, testing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting production integrations and data pipelines.
* Experience with data mapping, transformation, migration, reconciliation, master data, and data-quality controls.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis skills across applications, interfaces, data, security, and business processes.
* Experience with API security, token-based authentication, source control, code review, testing, deployment, environment management, and operational documentation.
* Ability to understand order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory, fulfillment, and accounting impacts in addition to technical specifications.
* Ability to evaluate and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations and assume ownership of the resulting design.
* Strong written communication and willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operation of the environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), NetSuite Integration Platform, and other Oracle integration technologies.
* Experience with SuiteTalk, SuiteScript, RESTlets, SuiteQL, SuiteAnalytics Connect, or NetSuite Analytics Warehouse.
* Knowledge of EDI standards and third-party integration processes.
* Experience in food distribution, wholesale distribution, retail, logistics, or other transaction-intensive industries.
* Experience modernizing Microsoft Dynamics GP or custom legacy applications.
* Familiarity with Oracle APEX, Power BI, cloud data platforms, workflow automation, or document processing.
* Experience with multi-entity environments, acquisitions, and high-volume order and inventory transactions.

**Why Join Relay Human Cloud? ✨**

🌍 Opportunities to work with global clients

🤝 Dynamic and collaborative work environment

⚖️ Excellent work-life balance – 5-day workweek

🩺 Comprehensive health & accident insurance

🌴 Generous paid time off and holidays

🍽️ Complimentary lunches & dinners

🏆 Quarterly, Semi-Annual & Annual recognition, rewards, and giveaways

📚 Employee development programs – Communication, Soft Skills, and more

🎉 Vibrant cultural events – Fun Fridays, Month-End Celebrations, Sports Tournaments, and Festival celebrations

description:
**Job Description**
Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Problems the team works on:**

* Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load.
* API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs.
* Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems.

**What you'll do:**

* Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time.
* Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams.
* Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed.
* Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work.
* Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries.

**What we're looking for:**

* Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production.
* A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services.
* Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management.
* Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production.
* A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar.

* Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams.

**Job Summary:**

The Senior Manager, NetSuite Enterprise Applications & Architecture will lead hands-on NetSuite implementation, configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing platform ownership. The role requires strong expertise in NetSuite financials, inventory, procurement, order management, and distribution workflows. The ideal candidate will drive solution design, validate business processes, maintain financial controls, and ensure a scalable, reliable ERP environment.

**Responsibilities:**

**NetSuite implementation and solution ownership**

* Participate directly in solution design, configuration, prototyping, testing, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization.
* Learn and document company's current processes, legacy applications, business rules, controls, data structures, and operational dependencies before replacing or redesigning them.
* Translate business requirements into practical NetSuite designs that favor standard functionality when it meets the business need.
* Review partner-proposed designs, identify gaps and downstream consequences, and challenge recommendations that create avoidable complexity, weak controls, or poor operational outcomes.
* Own material application design decisions and maintain functional architecture, configuration, decision, and support documentation.

**Financial management and controls**

* Support the design and configuration of general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash management, bank reconciliation, intercompany activity, financial dimensions, allocations, fixed assets, and period close
* Understand and validate the accounting consequences of transaction design across sales, purchasing, inventory, fulfillment, billing, returns, credits, and adjustments
* Protect subledger-to-general-ledger integrity through reconciliations, conversion validation, controlled posting logic, and clear exception handling.
* Partner with Finance to establish approvals, role permissions, audit trails, segregation of duties, and other control requirements.
* Validate financial reporting outputs and ensure configuration supports accurate, explainable, and repeatable close processes.

**Order to cash and customer operations**

* Design and support customer master data, sales orders, pricing, allocations, fulfillment, invoicing, payments, returns, credits, and related workflows.
* Support both owned-inventory and drop-ship transaction models, including customer-specific item references and order requirements.
* Evaluate the effect of design choices on customer service, warehouse execution, fulfillment accuracy, margin, and accounting.
* Work with process owners to define exceptions, approvals, controls, and measurable acceptance criteria for end-to-end customer transactions.

**Procure to pay inventory and warehouse processes**

* Design and support vendor master data, purchasing, purchase orders, receiving, vendor bills, matching, landed cost, payments, and returns.
* Support item master design, units of measure, locations, lot traceability, transfers, adjustments, cycle counts, costing, and inventory reconciliation.
* Address food-distribution requirements such as master case and break pack, assemblies, repack, catch weight, lot control, and related accounting flows when applicable.
* Confirm that application design works in the operating environment and does not shift hidden effort or control risk into warehouse, procurement, customer service, or Finance teams.

**Configuration administration and release governance**

* Configure or oversee roles, permissions, forms, fields, workflows, saved searches, dashboards, approval processes, and application preferences.
* Establish standards for configuration, customization, SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, naming, documentation, and environment management.
* Evaluate native functionality before approving extensions and ensure each customization has a clear owner, business purpose, test plan, and support approach.
* Maintain disciplined development, test, sandbox, and production practices with documented change control and release procedures.
* Support production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and manage an enhancement backlog based on business value, control risk, and operational need.

**Master data testing and cutover**

* Help define customer, vendor, item, pricing, chart-of-accounts, location, and other master-data structures, ownership, approval rights, and system-of-record boundaries.
* Participate in data mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with clear acceptance criteria.
* Develop and execute end-to-end test scenarios covering normal transactions, exceptions, integrations, financial posting, operational handoffs, and reporting.
* Take an active role in conference-room pilots, system and integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover rehearsals, go-live readiness, and hypercare.
* Reject incomplete testing or unresolved defects that could compromise financial integrity, inventory accuracy, customer service, or operational continuity.

**Long term platform ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner and subject-matter expert for the NetSuite application environment.
* Build sufficient internal knowledge to reduce unnecessary dependence on outside consultants while using specialized partners where they add value.
* Maintain current documentation, operating procedures, configuration standards, training materials, and decision history.
* Evaluate new capabilities and enhancements against business value, total cost, control implications, operational impact, and supportability.
* Help establish a scalable ERP operating model that can support organic growth, new operating requirements, and future acquisitions.

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of ERP implementation, enterprise applications, or ERP administration experience, including at least five years of meaningful hands-on NetSuite experience.
* Participation in at least one full-cycle NetSuite implementation with direct responsibility for design, configuration, testing, conversion, cutover, or stabilization.
* Strong knowledge of NetSuite financials and core ERP capabilities, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, order management, purchasing, and inventory.
* Working knowledge of accounting fundamentals, inventory accounting, financial controls, reconciliations, and subledger-to-general-ledger integrity.
* Demonstrated ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into practical, supportable system designs.
* Hands-on experience with roles, permissions, workflows, saved searches, reporting, master data, data conversion, and test execution.
* Ability to assess operational impacts and work effectively with Finance, procurement, operations, warehouse, customer service, and technology teams.
* Ability to evaluate and challenge consultant or vendor recommendations using business, accounting, control, data, and operational evidence.
* Strong documentation, troubleshooting, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Willingness to remain hands-on throughout implementation and long-term operation of the platform.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* NetSuite OneWorld experience and relevant NetSuite certifications.
* Food distribution, wholesale distribution, manufacturing, or another inventory-intensive industry background.
* Experience with lot-controlled inventory, catch weight, repack, assemblies, drop ship, EDI-enabled transactions, or complex pricing.
* Experience migrating from Microsoft Dynamics GP or another legacy ERP.
* Familiarity with SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, SuiteAnalytics, NetSuite APIs, and integration concepts.
* Experience supporting multi-entity or acquisition-driven organizations.
